api: assembleSlide(deck, slide, renderNode) returns a complete section.canvas.slide.overrides. The callback is always called with assembled=false to avoid recursive adapters.

foundation.title: Visible headings use h1.title; kicker, lead and meta are semantic p elements. A clipped accessibility h1 is added only if the original vector composition has no independently classified heading.
foundation.slots: Every direct .body child is .group with only grid-column and grid-row inline declarations. A relative reference-slot inside each group preserves local reference geometry.

grouping.algorithm: Choose unrotated rect surfaces >=120×60 and <65% canvas area, smallest first. Require at least 2 contained texts or text+icon. Greedily assign each original node once. Group text/icon/seat/pill into the same card.parts. Include local decorative strips and rules in source paint order. Exclude scattered backdrop furniture.
grouping.semanticParts: Each card contains actual .parts descendants .name, .fig, .note, .kick and .mark as appropriate. Numeric values are not made into unrelated standalone metrics.

d05Examples.s04: 3 performance cards: label + numeric figure + status in each card.parts
d05Examples.s05: 4 quadrant cards with icon, name and description
d05Examples.s07: 3 phase cards with local header strip, name, vector icon and description

tokens.palette: Deck palette supplies --page/--accent/--ink/--surface/--line. Unmatched precise reference colors use named --reference-color-N page tokens. Fonts use --font-body/--font-display or --reference-font-N.
tokens.typography: Font size references nearest --type-N plus a reference correction. Weight, tracking and line-height reference the appropriate library role token plus a reference correction. Changing library tokens therefore changes assembled content.

validation.browser: Real Chromium using Playwright; all 105 slide DOMs reconstructed and inspected.
validation.d05VisualReview: All seven newly assembled pages rendered and opened individually; then clone/assembled per-page side-by-side comparisons inspected. Local border-origin and header-strip paint-order regressions were corrected.

honestLimitations: This is deterministic geometry-assisted reconstruction, not authored semantic source data for every original chart.

Complex charts, tables, custom SVG diagrams, large background shapes, separators and ungrouped small atoms remain editable page decoration; they are not falsely claimed as library chart/table contracts.
Some pages have no eligible information-card surface and use foundation text/pill/frame plus page decoration.
Reference-specific geometry offsets and typography corrections are page overrides. The portable collection CSS and fixtures are unchanged.
